quests.title: Squid for the Sandbar
quests.summary: Captain Mac wants the stingrays fed, a raylette shown to him, and his rival put in his place.

steps.text: Get a bucket of squid from the Old Fisher on the quay.
Feed the stingray on the sandbar in the North Sound.
Catch a raylette in the shallows and show Captain Mac.
Beat Rival Diver Nasir on the shore, then tell Captain Mac.

quests.reward: A Silver Thatch Bracelet (a charm: storm moves hurt less).
